question: Does temperature move with PM10 in Mumbai?

final.answer: In Mumbai, measured PM10 showed a weak positive association with temperature (Spearman rho = 0.14 across 527 days). Mean PM10 was 80.3 µg/m³ on days with the lowest temperatures (23.2–26.5 °C) and 81.9 µg/m³ on days with the highest temperatures (29.6–32.5 °C).
final.headline: In Mumbai, measured PM10 showed a weak positive association with temperature (Spearman rho = 0.14 across 527 days). Mean PM10 was 80.3 µg/m³ on days with the lowest temperatures (23.2–26.5 °C) and 81.9 µg/m³ on days with the highest temperatures (29.6–32.5 °C).
final.explanation: Mean PM10 levels across temperature quartiles ranged from 68.2 µg/m³ in the second quartile to 85.2 µg/m³ in the third quartile. This analysis shows association rather than a direct relationship and includes periods with network-wide data gaps.
final.method: Measured PM + modelled weather: PM10 and temperature in Mumbai, 2025-02-18 to 2026-11-11. 22 primary stations (primary). 527 matched days. Method: Spearman rank correlation between daily city PM and the daily weather value; days grouped into quartiles (or dry/rain) to show average PM per group.
